common_universe: Both arms require the same observed M15/H1/H4/D history for the scored comparison. Broader paper preliminaries receive deep collection; no live gates relaxed.
cost_method: Executable-side OANDA bid/ask fills and exits; no double spread subtraction. Adverse stop gaps and 0/0.25/0.5 pip per-side stress. Financing crossing NY 17:00 and actual Pepperstone costs remain unknown unless evidenced.
delivery_method: Separate plan creation, completed trigger, detection, repository readback, first observed public serving and provider/user receipt. A public readback is not a ChatGPT push receipt. No delivery inferred from timestamps or tests.
independence_rule: Earliest scored fill per pair per London day per arm. Statistical comparison clustered by day; counts are eligibility floors, not proof of edge.
promotion_policy: No automatic promotion. Protocol changes invalidate the OOS study; sufficient sample, verified timely delivery, costs, and positive day-cluster improvement are minimum conditions for independent review.
